notes: Building Center Carrier page is history-only (https://www.building-center.org/carrier-hvac-age/, no serial system). Modern style is documented INDEPENDENTLY of Bryant/Payne files, in Carrier manufacturer documentation (brandportal product literature, serial-number nomenclature figure, repeated across 38AX, 38AU and 40RU documents): positions 1-2 = week of manufacture (fiscal calendar), 3-4 = year, 5 = manufacturing location, 6-10 = sequence number. Corroborated for residential equipment by Carrier Northwest (Carrier dealer site, example 5220 = 52nd week 2020) and SmartACSolutions (2714 = week 27 of 2014, mid-1990s to today). SCOPE CAVEAT: manufacturer documents cover commercial lines 38AX/38AU/40RU; the WWYY rule is corroborated, not manufacturer-proven, for residential lines. Older Carrier systems (1960s single-digit year, 1970s letter+digit, per inspector-training source only) are HELD, not drafted: incomplete and single-sourced. Week is a fiscal-calendar week per the manufacturer figure, not necessarily ISO week; recorded as week, as in Bryant/Payne files. Carrier derivation from Bryant/Payne was NOT used: no Bryant/Payne file content is cited as the source for this file.

styles.notes: Examples are the typical serials printed in the manufacturer nomenclature figures: 0525... = week 05, 2025 (38AXQ doc); 2623G12345 = week 26, 2023 (40RU doc); 0524... = week 05, 2024 (38AX doc). Position 5 is a location code (digit 9 in the 38AX typicals, letter G in the 40RU typical), hence [A-Z0-9].
